m.aarti.tek: The āratī of Śrī Janaka's darling daughter, of Sītā, beloved of Śrī Rāma.
m.aarti.pad1: Of the mother of the world, who unfolds the world, eternal and true, who dwells in Sāketa, supremely compassionate, uplifter of the lowly: of Mother Sītā, who does good to her devotees.
m.aarti.pad2: Of the crest-jewel of faithful wives, who works for her husband's good, who wandered from forest to forest to serve her husband, who for her husband's good accepted separation from him: of her who took the form of renunciation and dharma.
m.aarti.pad3: Of her whose spotless fame has spread through all the worlds, whose name, once spoken, brings purity of mind, at whose remembrance grievous troubles are cut away: of her who takes away the fear of those who come for refuge.
